before: Footer PAGE frames without a leading tab can ignore page-relative X and reserve an extra paragraph despite explicit floating exact-height text anchoring.
after: Supported PAGE/empty-anchor frames honor authored page-X. Bounded explicit exact-height frames with signed text-anchor Y clip to the authored frame and reserve only the real empty anchor.
reason: Only derived furniture geometry changes. Auto/atLeast, missing-Y, leading-tab and unsupported shapes retain their existing behavior. Canonical OOXML, ranges, fields and saved bytes stay unchanged.
